title: Year-Over-Year Sales Growth
scenario: Calculate the growth rate of total revenue (quantity * price) for each product year-over-year. Return 'product_id', 'year', and 'growth_rate'.
tableSchema: sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT)
hint: Use LAG() to get the previous year's revenue per product.
correctQuery: SELECT product_id, year, (current_revenue - prev_revenue) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev_revenue, 0) AS growth_rate FROM (SELECT product_id, year, SUM(quantity * price) AS current_revenue, LAG(SUM(quantity * price)) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY year) AS prev_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY product_id, year) t;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT); INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1, 100, 2008, 10, 5000), (2, 100, 2009, 15, 6000);
